|translation='''Title:''' Trouble has occurred.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to target an opponent's starfighter at a system where a battle has just ended. Draw destiny. If destiny is greater than maneuver, that starfighter is immediately lost.

'''Lore:''' Flying debris damaged Jek Porkins' X-wing, causing its computer and flight control equipment to fail.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title describes trouble occurring; the English title is a first-person statement.
